cryptoTrack.links.fieldHint: Optional. Shows this record next to the coins it is about, from both sides. It changes no amount and no total.
cryptoTrack.links.pending: An operation is chosen. The link is made when you save this record.
cryptoTrack.links.dialogHint: Operations within three days of this record, the ones whose value fits first. Nothing is linked until you choose.
cryptoTrack.links.emptyHint: Operations appear here once the module has read them. You can link later, from the operation's card.
cryptoTrack.links.recordMissing: The linked record was not found. It may have been deleted.
cryptoTrack.links.operationMissing: The linked operation was not found. It may no longer be in the module.
tour.cryptoOperations.pair.title: Linked record
tour.cryptoOperations.pair.body: The record from your ledger that this operation was linked to. It is only a pointer: no amount or total changes.
whatsNew.cryptoLinks.title: Link a record to a crypto operation
whatsNew.cryptoLinks.pointer: In the form of a payment or a top-up, «Crypto operation» points the record at the coins it is about; the operation's card shows the record back. The app only suggests, and the link changes no amount.
